assumptions.statement: Official regulatory, property, heritage, road, rail, water, municipal, fire, and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, parcel, capacity, demolition, construction, or implementation conclusion is made; official data requires complete recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Repository provisional polygons are used only as rough constraints for intake and internal geometry checks.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios have low confidence and cannot describe existing conditions or official controls.

assumptions.statement: No death, incapacity, proxy, succession, records-retention, data-export, or deletion rule is inferred by this proposal.
assumptions.impact: The prototype may test handover legibility, but only a competent human under applicable rules may determine facts, authority, retention, or disposition.

assumptions.statement: No affected-person, disability, bereavement, caregiver, frontline-worker, or records-professional review has occurred.
assumptions.impact: The room cannot claim dignity, accessibility, safety, or acceptability until independent co-review and a right to stop are established.

assumptions.statement: No real identity, likeness, voice, personal record, trigger document, service system, or vendor is connected.
assumptions.impact: Trigger accuracy, service continuity, retention, cost, and closeout performance remain unknown; only synthetic tabletop assertions are known.
